Messaging._comment: Seed defaults only. Used once, to create the app_settings row for a tenant that has none; after that the database row is authoritative and the owner edits it from Settings. Changing these does not change a gym that is already running.

ForwardedHeaders._comment: Reverse-proxy networks whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted. EMPTY BY DEFAULT ON PURPOSE: the header is caller-supplied, so an unconfigured deployment must trust nobody and partition the rate limiter on the socket address instead. Production sets this to the compose bridge subnet pinned in deployment/docker-compose.yml, and AllowedHosts to the real domain -- both via environment variables.
